title: serenoa serrulata
intro: Serenoa serrulata, commonly known as Saw Palmetto, is a plant native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), such as prostate enlargement, and improving urinary flow. The therapeutic actions of Saw Palmetto are attributed to its ability to inhibit 5-alpha-reductase, an enzyme that converts testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone linked to BPH. The bioactive constituents of Saw Palmetto include phytosterols, particularly beta-sitosterol, which may contribute to its health benefits.
